criteria.succeeds: the dossier is written to the deal with every fact sourced or marked OPEN, and the write logged
criteria.fails: a dossier fact has no source and is marked neither OPEN nor as an inference

criteria.succeeds: the meeting plan is a note on the deal, and the follow-up is a draft logged with its draft id
criteria.fails: a follow-up is sent rather than drafted, or no draft exists after the meeting notes arrived

criteria.succeeds: the proposal and the SoW exist, with the estimate's effort range and contingency attached
criteria.fails: the proposal quotes a price with no estimate behind it, or the SoW has no out-of-scope list

criteria.succeeds: each deal touched has a dated next activity, and any stage move is logged with its cited evidence
criteria.fails: a stage moved with no cited evidence, or a deal touched has no dated next activity
